name: Bench Press
howto: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades pinched together. Lower the bar to your mid chest, then press it back up over your shoulders. Keep your wrists straight and your bum on the bench.

name: Incline Bench Press
howto: Set the bench to a slight slope, lie back with shoulder blades pinched and feet flat. Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it straight up. Keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your body, not flared wide.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
howto: Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand, held over your chest. Lower them until your elbows are just below the bench, then press back up. Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
howto: Set the bench to a slight slope and hold the dumbbells at your upper chest. Press them up until your arms are straight, then lower slowly. Keep your back against the pad the whole time.

name: Push-Up
howto: Place your hands a little wider than your shoulders and make a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to near the floor, then push back up. Squeeze your stomach and bum so your hips do not sag.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
howto: Lie back with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent. Open your arms out wide in an arc until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together. Keep that small elbow bend the whole way.

name: Cable Crossover
howto: Stand in the middle with a handle in each hand, one foot forward and a slight lean. Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips. Keep your elbows slightly bent and control the return.

name: High-to-Low Cable Crossover
howto: Set both pulleys high. Stand in the middle with a handle in each hand, one foot forward and a slight lean. Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips, keeping your elbows slightly bent. This works the lower part of your chest. Control the way back up.

name: Mid Cable Crossover
howto: Set both pulleys at shoulder height. Stand in the middle with a handle in each hand, one foot forward, arms out wide and elbows slightly bent. Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide hugging arc, then open slowly. This works the middle of your chest.

name: Low-to-High Cable Crossover
howto: Set both pulleys low. Stand in the middle with a handle in each hand, one foot forward and your hands by your hips. Sweep your hands up and together to the height of your chin, keeping your elbows slightly bent. This works the upper part of your chest. Lower slowly.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
howto: Lie on the decline bench with your feet secured and hands just wider than your shoulders. Lower the bar to your lower chest, then press it back up. Keep the bar moving in a controlled line.

name: Machine Chest Press
howto: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest. Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, then return slowly. Keep your back against the pad and shoulders down.

name: Chest Dip
howto: Grip the bars and lift yourself up, then lean your body forward a little. Lower until you feel a stretch in your chest, then push back up. Keep your elbows pointing slightly out.

name: Incline Cable Flye
howto: Set a bench at a slight slope between the cables, a handle in each hand. With soft elbows, bring your hands in an arc up and together over your upper chest. Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Pec Deck Fly
howto: Sit with your back flat on the pad and your arms on the pads or handles at chest height. Bring your arms together in front of you, then return slowly. Do not let the weight stack drop between reps.

name: Pull-Up
howto: Hang from the bar with hands a little wider than your shoulders. Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down. Lower all the way until your arms are straight, without swinging.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
howto: Hold the bar, hinge forward at your hips with a flat back and soft knees. Pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower it slowly. Keep your back flat and do not stand up as you pull.

name: Seated Cable Row
howto: Sit with your feet braced and knees slightly bent, holding the handle with arms straight. Pull the handle to your stomach while squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your chest tall and do not rock back.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
howto: Sit with your thighs under the pad and grip the bar wider than your shoulders. Pull the bar down to your upper chest, leaning back slightly. Control the bar back up until your arms are straight.

name: Barbell Deadlift
howto: Stand with the bar over your mid foot, hinge down and grip it just outside your legs. Brace your stomach, keep your back flat, and push the floor away to stand up tall. Lower the bar back along your legs.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
howto: Put one hand and one knee on a bench with a flat back, a dumbbell in the other hand. Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, then lower it slowly. Keep your shoulders square and do not twist.

name: Chin-Up
howto: Hang from the bar with palms facing you, hands about shoulder width. Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: T-Bar Row
howto: Stand over the bar with knees bent and your chest forward with a flat back. Pull the handle up toward your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower it slowly without rounding your back.

name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
howto: Sit with your thighs secured and hold the close handle with arms straight. Pull it down to your upper chest, elbows going down and back. Return slowly and keep your chest up.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
howto: Stand facing the cable and hold the bar with straight arms, leaning forward a little. Sweep the bar down in an arc to your thighs. Keep your arms nearly straight and let your back do the work.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
howto: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees. Pull both dumbbells up to your ribs, then lower slowly. Keep your neck in line with your back.

name: Machine High Row
howto: Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad. Pull the handles back and down toward your ribs, then return slowly. Keep your chest on the pad and shoulders down.

name: Back Extension
howto: Lie face down on the bench with your hips on the pad and feet secured. Lower your upper body down, then raise it until your body is in a straight line. Do not arch past a straight line at the top.

name: Barbell Shrug
howto: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs, hands shoulder width. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, then lower. Keep your arms straight and do not roll your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
howto: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, then lower slowly. Keep your arms straight and your head still.

name: Overhead Press
howto: Hold the bar at your upper chest with your feet shoulder width apart. Press it straight up overhead until your arms are straight. Squeeze your bum and stomach so your lower back does not arch.

name: Lateral Raise
howto: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, elbows slightly bent. Raise your arms out to the side until they reach shoulder height, then lower slowly. Lead with your elbows and do not swing.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howto: Sit with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Press them up until your arms are straight, then lower to your shoulders. Keep your back against the pad and ribs down.

name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
howto: Start with the dumbbells in front of your chest, palms facing you. Press up while rotating your palms to face forward, finishing with arms straight. Reverse the turn as you lower.

name: Face Pull
howto: Set the cable at about face height with a rope and step back, arms straight. Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends apart past your ears. Keep your elbows high and control the return.

name: Seated Face Pull
howto: Sit facing a cable set at about face height, holding a rope with arms straight. Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends apart past your ears. Keep your elbows high and your back upright, and control the return.

name: Front Dumbbell Raise
howto: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs. Raise one or both arms straight forward to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Keep your body still and do not lean back.

name: Rear Delt Fly
howto: Lean forward with a flat back, or lie chest down on an incline bench, a dumbbell in each hand. Raise your arms out to the sides with a slight elbow bend, squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower slowly.

name: Machine Shoulder (Military) Press
howto: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height. Press them up until your arms are almost straight, then lower with control. Keep your back on the pad and do not shrug.

name: Upright Row
howto: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with hands about shoulder width. Pull it up toward your chin, leading with your elbows, and stop when they reach shoulder height. Lower slowly and keep the bar close to your body.

name: Seated Cable Lateral Raise
howto: Sit sideways to the cable and hold the handle with the far hand, elbow slightly bent. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Keep your body still.

name: Reverse Machine Flyes
howto: Sit facing the pad with your chest on it and hold the handles out in front. Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc, squeezing your shoulder blades. Return slowly without letting the weights crash.

name: Barbell Curl
howto: Stand holding the bar with palms up and elbows by your sides. Curl the bar up to your shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep your elbows still and do not swing your back.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
howto: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward. Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep your elbows by your sides and your body still.

name: Hammer Curl
howto: Hold the dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other. Curl them up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists. Lower slowly and keep your elbows in.

name: Preacher Curl
howto: Sit with your upper arms resting on the angled pad. Curl the bar up, then lower it slowly until your arms are almost straight. Do not lift your elbows off the pad.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
howto: Sit back on an incline bench with your arms hanging down, a dumbbell in each hand. Curl the weights up without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly. Keep your shoulders back against the pad.

name: Cable Curl
howto: Stand facing the low cable and hold the bar with palms up. Curl it up toward your shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep your elbows by your sides.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
howto: Hold the bent bar on the angled grips with palms up. Curl it to your shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your back still.

name: Concentration Curl
howto: Sit with your elbow resting against your inner thigh and a dumbbell hanging down. Curl it up toward your shoulder, then lower slowly. Keep your upper arm still and your back straight.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
howto: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad. Curl the handles toward your shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep your elbows on the pad and do not let the weight drop.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
howto: Stand facing the low cable and hold the rope with palms facing each other. Curl it up toward your shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep your elbows by your sides.

name: Triceps Pushdown
howto: Stand facing the high cable and hold the bar with elbows by your sides. Push the bar down until your arms are straight, then let it rise slowly. Keep your elbows still and tucked in.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
howto: Lie on the bench and hold the bar with hands about shoulder width. Lower it to your lower chest with your elbows close to your body, then press up. Keep your wrists straight.

name: Triceps Dip
howto: Grip the bars and lift yourself up, keeping your body upright. Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees, then push back up. Keep your elbows close to your body.

name: Skullcrusher
howto: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your chest with arms straight. Bend only your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then press it back up. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
howto: Stand facing the high cable and hold the rope with elbows by your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, spreading the rope ends apart at the bottom. Return slowly.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
howto: Face away from the cable with the rope behind your head, one foot forward. Straighten your arms up and forward, then bend slowly back. Keep your elbows pointing forward and still.

name: Tricep Dumbbell Kickback
howto: Hinge forward with a flat back and hold your upper arm against your side. Straighten your arm back until it is level with your body, then bend slowly. Keep your upper arm still.

name: Bench Dips
howto: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you, then slide your hips forward off it. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up. Keep your back close to the bench.

name: Machine Triceps Extension
howto: Sit with your upper arms on the pad and hold the handles. Push down until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Keep your elbows still and your back on the pad.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
howto: Hold one dumbbell overhead with your arm straight and your elbow near your ear. Bend your elbow to lower the weight behind your head, then press back up. Keep your upper arm still.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
howto: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and your wrists past your knees, palms up. Let the bar roll down to your fingers, then curl it back up with your wrists. Keep your forearms still.

name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
howto: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms down, wrists past your knees. Lower the bar by bending your wrists down, then lift it back up. Use a light weight and keep your forearms still.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
howto: Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm up, with your wrist just past the edge. Lower the dumbbell, then curl it up using only your wrist. Keep your forearm still.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
howto: Rest your forearm on a bench, palm down, with your wrist past the edge. Lower the dumbbell, then lift it back up using only your wrist. Use a light weight.

name: Wrist Roller
howto: Hold the roller out in front of you at shoulder height with arms straight. Twist your wrists to wind the rope up and raise the weight, then lower it slowly. Keep your arms steady.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
howto: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a low cable handle. Curl your wrist up, then lower slowly. Keep your forearm still and use only your wrist.

name: Crunch
howto: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head. Lift your shoulders off the floor by curling your ribs toward your hips, then lower slowly. Do not pull on your neck.

name: Cable Crunch
howto: Kneel (or sit, as pictured) facing the high cable with the rope by your head. Curl your elbows toward your knees by rounding your spine, then return slowly. Move only your upper body, not your hips.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
howto: Hang from a bar with your arms straight. Raise your legs up in front of you as high as you can, then lower slowly. Do not swing, and tilt your hips up at the top.

name: Plank
howto: Rest on your forearms and toes with your elbows under your shoulders. Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels. Squeeze your stomach and breathe steadily.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
howto: Sit with the pads against your chest or shoulders and your feet secured. Crunch forward by curling your ribs toward your hips, then return slowly. Move your stomach, not your arms.

name: Russian Twist
hint: Twist your upper body side to side, touching the weight to the floor by each hip.
howto: Sit with your knees bent and lean back until your stomach is working. Twist your upper body from side to side, touching the weight down by each hip. Keep your chest tall and your feet steady.

name: Reverse Crunch
howto: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lifted. Curl your hips off the floor by pulling your knees toward your chest, then lower slowly. Use your stomach and do not swing.

name: Ab Roller
howto: Kneel holding the wheel under your shoulders. Roll forward slowly while keeping your back flat, then pull back using your stomach. Stop before your lower back sags.

name: Sit-Up
howto: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Curl your upper body up until you are sitting, then lower slowly. Keep your neck relaxed and do not yank on your head.

name: Bosu Ball Crunch
howto: Lie back on the dome of the Bosu with your lower back on top, knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your hands by your head and curl your shoulders up by squeezing your belly, then lower slowly. Do not pull on your neck.

name: Pallof Press
howto: Stand sideways to a cable at chest height, holding the handle at your chest. Press your hands straight out and hold for a moment, then bring them back. Do not let the cable twist you.
hint: Press straight out and hold. Don't let the cable turn your body.

name: Barbell Squat
howto: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet about shoulder width. Sit down and back until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand up. Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

name: Leg Press
howto: Sit with your back flat on the pad and your feet shoulder width on the platform. Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees, then push back. Do not lock your knees hard at the top.

name: Front Squat
howto: Hold the bar across the front of your shoulders with your elbows high. Sit straight down until your thighs are level with the floor, then stand up. Keep your elbows up and your chest tall.

name: Leg Extension
howto: Sit with the pad on your lower shins and your back against the seat. Straighten your legs fully, then lower slowly. Do not swing the weight up.

name: Hack Squat
howto: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and feet shoulder width. Lower until your thighs are about level with the floor, then push back up. Keep your back and hips against the pad.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
howto: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand. Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees, then push back to the start. Keep your torso upright.

name: Goblet Squat
howto: Hold one weight at your chest with both hands. Sit down between your knees until your thighs are level or lower, then stand up. Keep your chest tall and your heels on the floor.

name: Barbell Lunge
howto: Rest the bar on your upper back. Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees, then push back to the start. Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your foot.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
howto: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in front of a sturdy box. Step up with one foot and stand tall on top, then lower back down with control. Push through the heel of the top foot.

name: Static Lunge (Split Squat)
howto: Stand with one foot a long step in front, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push back up. Keep your torso upright and stay on the same spot.
hint: Lower straight down and stand back up. Your feet stay in place.

name: Smith Machine Squat
howto: Stand under the bar with feet slightly in front of you. Lower until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand up. Keep your chest up and your back flat.

name: Romanian Deadlift
howto: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with soft knees. Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand tall. Keep your back flat and the bar close.

name: Lying Leg Curl
howto: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels. Curl your heels up toward your bum, then lower slowly. Keep your hips pressed down on the bench.

name: Seated Leg Curl
howto: Sit with the pad above your heels and your thighs held down. Curl your heels back and down, then return slowly. Keep your back against the seat.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
howto: Stand holding the bar with your knees only slightly bent. Hinge at your hips and lower the bar down your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand up. Keep your back flat the whole time.

name: Good Morning
howto: Rest a light bar on your upper back with soft knees. Push your hips back and lean forward with a flat back until your torso is almost level, then stand up. Keep your chest up.

name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
howto: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs with soft knees. Hinge at your hips and lower the weights down your legs, then stand tall. Keep your back flat.

name: Glute Ham Raise
howto: Secure your feet and rest your thighs on the pad. Lower your body forward, then curl back up using your hamstrings and glutes. Keep your body in a straight line.

name: Standing Leg Curl
howto: Stand facing the machine with the pad behind your lower calf. Curl your heel up toward your bum, then lower slowly. Keep your hips still and your standing leg soft.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
howto: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar across your hips. Drive your hips up until your body is level from shoulders to knees, then lower. Keep your chin tucked and squeeze your bum.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
howto: Lie on your back with knees bent and the bar across your hips. Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is in a straight line. Squeeze your bum and lower slowly.

name: Glute Kickback (Hands and Knees)
howto: Start on your hands and knees with a flat back and hands under your shoulders. Keeping your knee bent, kick one leg back and up until your thigh is level with your back, squeeze your bum, then lower slowly. Do not arch your lower back.

name: One-Legged Cable Kickback
howto: Clip the ankle strap on and face the cable, holding the machine for balance. Kick your leg straight back, squeezing your glute, then return slowly. Keep your torso still.

name: Pull Through
howto: Face away from a low cable, with the rope between your legs. Push your hips back with a flat back, then drive them forward and stand tall. Keep your arms straight and squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
howto: Sit with the pads outside your knees and your back against the seat. Push your knees apart, then return slowly. Do not let the weights slam together.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
howto: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted. Push through your heel to raise your hips until your body is straight, then lower slowly. Keep your hips level.

name: Standing Calf Raise
howto: Stand with the pads on your shoulders and the balls of your feet on the platform. Rise up as high as you can, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch. Keep your knees nearly straight.

name: Seated Calf Raise
howto: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform. Push up onto your toes, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch. Move slowly.

name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
howto: Sit in the leg press with your feet low on the platform and legs nearly straight. Push with your toes, then let your heels sink back for a stretch. Do not bend your knees.

name: Standing Barbell Calf Raise
howto: Stand with the bar on your upper back and the balls of your feet on a raised edge. Rise up onto your toes, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch. Keep your knees nearly straight.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
howto: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, the balls of your feet on a raised edge. Rise up onto your toes, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch. Hold on to something for balance.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
howto: Stand under the bar with the balls of your feet on a raised edge. Rise up onto your toes, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch. Keep your knees nearly straight.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
howto: Bend forward at your hips with your hands supported and the balls of your feet on a raised edge. Rise up onto your toes, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch. Keep your knees straight.

name: Cable Front Raise
howto: Stand facing away from a low pulley with the handle in one hand between your legs. Raise your arm straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower it slowly. Keep your body still and your elbow almost straight.

name: Cable Upright Row
howto: Stand at a low pulley holding the bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart. Pull the bar up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows. Lower it slowly without leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
howto: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs. Pull them up close to your body until they reach chest height, elbows pointing out and up. Lower them under control.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
howto: Stand beside a low pulley, bend forward from the hips and take the handle with the far hand. Raise your arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder, then lower it slowly. Keep your back flat and your elbow slightly bent.

name: Lying Leg Raise
howto: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips. Raise your legs together until they point at the ceiling, then lower them almost to the floor. Keep your lower back pressed down and do not swing.

name: Incline Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howto: Sit on a bench set at a steep angle with a dumbbell at each shoulder. Press them up until your arms are straight, then lower them back to shoulder height. Keep your back against the pad.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howto: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your shoulder. Press it straight overhead until your arm is straight, then lower it back slowly. Keep your ribs down and do all the reps on one side before switching.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
howto: Lie across a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest. Lower it back behind your head in a smooth arc, elbows slightly bent, until you feel a stretch. Bring it back over your chest.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
howto: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides of your chest. Press them up until your arms are straight, then lower them with control. Keep your feet locked in and your shoulder blades pinched.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
howto: Lie on an incline bench with the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other. Open your arms out wide in an arc with a slight bend in the elbows. Squeeze the dumbbells back together over your chest.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
howto: Lie on a flat bench under the Smith bar with your eyes below it. Unhook the bar, lower it to your mid chest, then press it back up. Set the bench so the bar comes down in line with your chest.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
howto: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with your feet flat. Unhook the bar, lower it to your upper chest, then press it up until your arms are straight. Keep your shoulder blades pinched.

name: Inverted Row
howto: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and hold it with an overhand grip. Keep your body straight and pull your chest up to the bar. Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
howto: Sit at the pulldown machine and hold the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder width apart. Pull the bar down to your upper chest while you lean back slightly. Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Superman
howto: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front of you. Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time and squeeze your back and glutes. Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

name: Walking Lunge
howto: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step forward into a lunge until both knees are bent about 90 degrees. Push through the front foot and step the back leg forward into the next lunge. Keep your chest up and take long steps.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
howto: Rest a barbell across your upper back. Step one foot back and lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor. Push through the front foot to stand up and repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Squat
howto: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor. Drive up through your heels.

name: Overhead Squat
howto: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip. Squat down as low as you can while keeping the bar over your mid foot and your chest up. Stand back up, keeping your arms straight the whole time.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
howto: Sit in the machine with your legs on the pads and the weight set so you can start with them apart. Squeeze your thighs together, pause, then let them open slowly. Keep your back against the seat.

name: Seated Dip Machine
howto: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your hands on the handles. Press the handles down until your arms are straight. Let them come back up slowly without letting your shoulders roll forward.

name: JM Press
howto: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a close grip. Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your chin and upper chest, with your elbows pointing forward. Press it back up by straightening your arms.

name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
howto: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head. Straighten your arms to bring them back up, keeping your upper arms still.

name: Diamond Push-Up
howto: Get into a push-up position with your hands close together under your chest so your thumbs and fingers form a diamond. Lower your chest to your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body. Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown
howto: Stand at a high pulley and hold the bar with an underhand grip, elbows pinned to your sides. Push the bar down until your arms are straight. Let it rise slowly to chest height without moving your elbows.

name: Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
howto: Sit on a bench with a barbell held overhead in both hands. Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears. Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
howto: Stand holding one dumbbell with both hands above your head. Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then straighten your arms to raise it again. Keep your elbows pointing forward and your core tight.

name: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown
howto: Stand at a high pulley and grip the V-bar with your elbows tucked in at your sides. Push the bar down until your arms are straight. Let it come back up slowly, keeping your elbows still.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
howto: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing in. Curl one dumbbell up across your body towards the opposite shoulder, then lower it and switch arms. Keep your elbows by your sides.

name: Drag Curl
howto: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl it up by pulling your elbows back so the bar slides up close to your body. Lower it the same way, keeping the bar against you.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
howto: Sit at the machine with your upper arms resting flat on the pad and your hands on the handles. Curl the handles up until your hands are near your shoulders, then lower slowly. Do not let your arms swing off the pad.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
howto: Rest the back of one upper arm on a preacher pad or the top of an incline bench. Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, then lower it slowly until your arm is nearly straight. Finish all the reps on one arm, then switch.

name: Spider Curl
howto: Lie face down on an incline bench and let your arms hang straight down holding a barbell. Curl the bar up towards your shoulders without moving your upper arms. Lower it slowly.

name: Zottman Curl
howto: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and curl them up with your palms facing up. At the top, turn your palms to face down and lower the weights slowly. Turn them back up at the bottom and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
howto: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing down. Curl the weights up towards your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight. Lower them slowly and keep your elbows by your sides.

name: Seated One-Leg Calf Raise
howto: Sit on a bench with the ball of one foot on a block and a dumbbell resting on that knee. Lift your heel as high as you can, pause, then lower it below the block for a stretch. Finish all the reps on one leg, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
howto: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Bend sideways at your waist towards the weight, then use your side muscles to come back upright. Keep your hips still and do all reps on one side before switching.

name: Roman Chair Side Bend
howto: Lie sideways on a 45 degree hyperextension bench with the pad under your hip and your feet hooked under the pads. Bend down sideways from your waist, then use your side muscles to lift your body back in line. Move slowly, do all reps on one side before switching. Hold a plate against your chest if you want it harder.

name: Bicycle Crunch
howto: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees raised. Bring one elbow towards the opposite knee while you straighten the other leg, then switch sides in a pedalling motion. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
howto: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head. Curl up and twist so one elbow moves towards the opposite knee. Lower back down and repeat to the other side.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
howto: Clip an ankle strap to a low pulley and face the machine, holding the frame for balance. Keeping your leg nearly straight, kick it straight back and squeeze your bum, then return slowly. Do not lean forward or arch your lower back.

name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
howto: Set the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest. Press forward and up until your arms are almost straight, then return slowly. Keep your back flat on the pad and shoulders down.

name: Incline Push-Up
howto: Put your hands on a bench a little wider than your shoulders and walk your feet back into a straight line. Lower your chest to the edge, then push away. Easier than a floor push-up and hits the lower chest.

name: Decline Push-Up
howto: Put your feet on a bench and hands on the floor, a little wider than your shoulders. Keep your body straight and lower your chest toward the floor, then push back up. Hits the upper chest and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
howto: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and your knees bent. Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, pause, then press up. The floor stops the stretch, so it is easy on the shoulders.

name: Wide-Grip Bench Press
howto: Set up like a normal bench press but take the bar with your hands well outside shoulder width. Lower to your mid chest and press up. Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

name: Cable Chest Press
howto: Stand facing away from the stack with a handle in each hand at chest height and one foot forward. Press both hands straight out until your arms are almost straight, then return slowly. Brace your stomach so you do not lean.

name: Svend Press
howto: Squeeze a light plate between your palms at chest height. Push it straight out in front of you, then pull it back in while still squeezing hard. Use a light plate, it is a squeeze exercise.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
howto: Lie back and press two dumbbells together over your chest. Keep squeezing them into each other while you lower and press. This keeps the inner chest working the whole rep.

name: Wide Push-Up
howto: Place your hands clearly wider than your shoulders and keep your body straight. Lower your chest between your hands, then push up. Hits the outer chest more than a normal push-up.

name: TRX Push-Up
howto: Hold the handles at chest height and lean forward on your toes in a straight line. Lower your chest between your hands, then push up while keeping the straps steady. The unstable handles make your core and shoulders work harder.

name: Single-Arm Cable Crossover
howto: Set a handle at shoulder height or higher and stand sideways. Sweep your arm across your body in an arc, squeeze, and return slowly. Keep a small bend in your elbow throughout.

name: Low-Incline Dumbbell Press
howto: Set the bench to a very small slope. Press the dumbbells from your upper chest to straight arms, then lower slowly. Favors the upper chest with less shoulder than a steep incline.

name: Seated Row (Machine)
howto: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab the handles. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly. Do not lean back to move the weight.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
howto: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Row the weights up toward your hips, squeeze, and lower under control. The bench removes lower-back swing.

name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
howto: Kneel or stand on the pad and set a counterweight, more weight makes it easier. Grab the handles and pull your chest up, then lower under control. Lower the assistance as you get stronger.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
howto: Stand inside the trap bar with feet hip-width and grip the handles. Brace your stomach, push the floor away and stand up tall. Lower the bar under control to the floor.

name: Sumo Deadlift
howto: Take a wide stance with toes turned out and grip the bar inside your knees. Push your knees out, keep your chest up and stand tall. Lower the bar back along your legs.

name: Pendlay Row
howto: Bend over with your back flat and torso close to parallel to the floor. Row the bar to your lower chest from a dead stop on the floor each rep, then lower it back down. Keep your hips still.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
howto: Take the bar clearly wider than shoulder width. Pull your chest toward the bar, then lower to a full hang. Think of driving your elbows down.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
howto: Sit at the pulldown with one handle and pull your elbow down and in toward your hip. Feel the lat squeeze, then let the arm rise slowly to a full stretch. Do not twist your body.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
howto: Hold one handle and pull your elbow back past your ribs while keeping your torso still. Squeeze your lat, then reach forward again. Do not rotate your shoulders.

name: Rack Pull
howto: Set the bar on the rack at knee height. Grip it, tighten your back and stand up, pushing your hips forward. Lower the bar back down to the pins. A top-half deadlift for the upper back.

name: Landmine Row
howto: Straddle the bar and hinge forward with a flat back. Pull the handle to your chest, squeeze, then lower slowly. Keep your hips still.

name: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
howto: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab the handles. Pull each arm back by driving the elbows behind you, then return with a full stretch. Arms work separately so a weaker side cannot hide.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
howto: Lie face down with your hips at the edge and legs hanging. Squeeze your glutes and swing your legs up until in line with your body, then lower slowly. Do not swing with momentum.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
howto: Attach weight with a belt or vest and hang with a grip just wider than shoulders. Pull your chest to the bar and lower fully. Add weight gradually.

name: TRX Row
howto: Hold the handles and lean back with your body straight. Pull your chest to your hands, squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

name: Cable Shrug
howto: Hold a bar or handles on a low pulley with your arms straight. Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, hold, and lower slowly. Do not roll your shoulders.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
howto: Hold the Smith bar in front of your thighs with straight arms. Shrug straight up, pause, and lower slowly. Do not roll your shoulders or bend your elbows.

name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
howto: Sit under the handles and grab them. Pull your elbows down toward your sides while keeping your chest tall. Return slowly to a full stretch.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
howto: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with the far hand. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, then lower slowly. The cable keeps tension at the bottom.

name: Push Press
howto: Hold the bar at your shoulders, dip slightly by bending your knees, then drive up with your legs and press the bar overhead. Lower it back to your shoulders. Your legs start the lift, your shoulders finish it.

name: Landmine Press
howto: Hold the end of the bar at your shoulder and press it up and forward along its arc. Lower it slowly. Keep your ribs down and do not lean back.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
howto: Sit under the bar with the bench upright and lower it to chin level. Press it straight up until your arms are almost straight. Control it on the way down.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
howto: Hold the kettlebell at your shoulder with your wrist straight. Press it overhead and finish with your bicep by your ear. Lower it back to your shoulder.

name: Pike Push-Up
howto: Start in a push-up position then walk your feet in so your hips point to the ceiling. Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor, then push back up. A bodyweight shoulder press.

name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
howto: Sit with your arms against the pads. Lift your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height, then lower slowly. Do not shrug.

name: Band Pull-Apart
howto: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with straight arms. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, then return slowly. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.

name: Plate Front Raise
howto: Hold a plate with both hands at the bottom of your thighs. Raise it to eye level with straight arms, then lower slowly. Do not lean back.

name: Rear Delt Row
howto: Hinge forward with dumbbells hanging. Row them up with elbows wide out to the sides, so your arms go level with your shoulders. Squeeze the back of the shoulders.

name: Barbell Front Raise
howto: Hold a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip. Raise it to shoulder height with straight arms, then lower with control. Keep your back tall.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
howto: Sit on an upright bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Curl them up one or both together and lower slowly. Seated means no body swing.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
howto: Stand facing away from the low pulley with the handle behind you in one hand. Curl up keeping your elbow behind your torso, then lower slowly. The arm starts stretched which hits the biceps hard.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
howto: Hold a handle on a low pulley, elbow close to your side. Curl up, squeeze, and lower slowly. Do not swing.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
howto: Lie back on an incline bench with arms hanging, palms facing in. Curl both dumbbells up with thumbs on top, then lower fully. The stretch hits the long head.

name: Overhead Cable Curl
howto: Stand between two high pulleys holding handles with arms out to the sides. Curl the handles toward your head like a double biceps pose, then extend slowly.

name: Single-Arm Triceps Pushdown
howto: Hold a single handle on a high pulley with your elbow at your side. Press down to straight arm, then return slowly. Do not lean on the weight.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Extension
howto: Face away from a low pulley, hold the handle overhead with your elbow pointing up. Extend your arm up to straight, then lower slowly. Keep the elbow in place.

name: Weighted Triceps Dip
howto: Hang weight from a belt and do dips on parallel bars. Stay upright to focus on the triceps. Lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
howto: Hinge forward holding a handle at your side. Straighten your arm back, squeeze, and return slowly. Keep your upper arm fixed.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
howto: Hold the bar with palms facing down, shoulder width. Curl it up keeping your wrists straight, then lower slowly. Hits the top of the forearms.

name: Farmer's Walk
howto: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand and stand tall. Walk with short quick steps without leaning. Great for grip and traps.

name: Dead Hang
howto: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and arms straight. Keep your shoulders active and breathe. Hold as long as you can, a grip and shoulder health builder.

name: Reverse EZ-Bar Curl
howto: Hold the EZ bar overhand on the angled parts. Curl up with your elbows at your sides, then lower slowly. Easier on the wrists than a straight bar.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
howto: Hold a straight bar or EZ attachment on a low pulley, palms down. Curl up and lower slowly. Cable keeps tension at the bottom.

name: Suitcase Carry
howto: Hold a heavy weight on one side and walk tall without leaning. Do not let the weight pull you sideways. Switch sides.

name: Side Plank
howto: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder. Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, hold, and breathe. Switch sides.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
howto: Hang from a bar and pull your knees up toward your chest, curling your hips. Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
howto: Support yourself on the pads with your back against the backrest. Raise your knees or straight legs up and lower slowly.

name: Hollow Body Hold
howto: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor. Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches and hold the banana shape.

name: L-Sit
howto: Support yourself on straight arms with your legs straight out in front, parallel to the floor. Press down and hold. Bend your knees to make it easier.

name: Dead Bug
howto: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower the opposite arm and leg while your lower back stays flat, then switch. Move slowly.

name: V-Up
howto: Lie flat with arms overhead. Lift your legs and torso at the same time to touch your toes in a V shape, then lower.

name: Decline Sit-Up
howto: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench. Curl up to sit, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Woodchop
howto: Stand sideways to a high pulley, hold the handle with both hands. Pull diagonally down across your body, rotating your torso. Return slowly.

name: Mountain Climber
howto: Start in a high plank. Drive one knee to your chest then switch quickly, like running in place. Keep hips low.

name: Bird Dog
howto: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back. Hold briefly, return and switch. Keep your back flat.

name: Flutter Kicks
howto: Lie on your back and lift your legs a few inches. Kick them up and down in small alternating motions with your lower back pressed down.

name: Stability Ball Crunch
howto: Lie back on a ball with your lower back supported. Curl your upper body up, then lower. The ball gives a longer stretch.

name: Toes to Bar
howto: Hang from a bar and lift your straight legs until your toes touch the bar. Lower with control. Advanced, build up with knee raises.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
howto: Put your rear foot on a bench, front foot far enough forward. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then drive up through your front foot. Hold dumbbells for extra load.

name: Wall Sit
howto: Slide down a wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Keep your back flat and hold. Knees stay over ankles.

name: Bodyweight Squat
howto: Stand with feet shoulder width. Sit back and down until your thighs are parallel, then stand. Arms forward for balance.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
howto: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Step back and lower your back knee, then push through your front foot to return. Easier on the knees than forward lunges.

name: Lateral Lunge
howto: Step wide to the side and sit back onto that leg while the other stays straight. Push back to start. Hold a weight for extra.

name: Jump Squat
howto: Squat down then explode up into a jump. Land softly back into the squat.

name: Box Jump
howto: Stand in front of a box. Swing your arms and jump onto it, landing softly. Step down to reset.

name: Single-Leg Press
howto: Place one foot on the platform. Lower under control and press back. Keep your hips flat on the seat.

name: Single-Leg Extension
howto: Use one leg at a time on the machine. Extend until straight and lower slowly. Fixes strength imbalances.

name: Sled Push
howto: Lean into the sled with straight arms and drive with short steps. Keep your back flat.

name: Pendulum Squat
howto: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad. Lower deeply on the arc and press back up. Great quad stretch.

name: Pistol Squat
howto: Stand on one leg with the other straight out front. Lower down as far as you can, then stand. Hold a support if needed.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
howto: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs. Push your hips back, sliding the weights down your legs with soft knees. Feel the hamstring stretch, then stand.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
howto: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell. Hinge forward while the other leg lifts behind you. Return to stand.

name: Kettlebell Swing
howto: Hinge back with the kettlebell between your legs. Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height. Let it fall and hinge again.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
howto: Kneel with your feet anchored. Lower your body forward as slowly as you can, catching with your hands, then push back up.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
howto: Lie on your back with heels on the ball. Lift your hips and curl the ball toward your bum, then extend.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
howto: Hold the Smith bar in front of your thighs. Hinge back, sliding it down your legs, then stand.

name: Glute Bridge
howto: Lie on your back with knees bent. Lift your hips, squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
howto: Sit with your back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips. Drive your hips up until your body is straight, squeeze, then lower.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
howto: Set up for a hip thrust with one foot on the floor and the other leg raised. Drive up through one heel and lower.

name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
howto: Sit in the machine with the pad over your hips. Drive up through your heels and squeeze, then lower.

name: Curtsy Lunge
howto: Step one foot behind and across the other as you lower. Push back up to standing.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
howto: Place a band around your knees or ankles. Take small steps sideways in a half squat.

name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction
howto: Attach a cuff to a low pulley and lift your leg out to the side. Return slowly.

name: Sumo Squat
howto: Take a wide stance with toes out and hold a dumbbell between your legs. Squat down and stand.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
howto: Stand and press your foot back against the pad. Squeeze at the end.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
howto: Place a bar over your hips on the Smith machine. Thrust up and squeeze.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
howto: Stand on a step or floor with heels free. Rise onto your toes then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
howto: Stand on one foot on a step. Rise as high as you can and lower fully. Hold a rail for balance.

name: One-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
howto: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, stand on a step on the same-side foot. Raise and lower.

name: Tibialis Raise
howto: Lean against a wall with heels forward. Pull your toes up toward your shins, then lower.

name: Single-Leg Calf Press
howto: Place one foot on the leg press platform. Press through your toes and lower slowly.

name: Standing Calf Raise (Plate-Loaded)
howto: Stand under the shoulder pads. Rise up and lower down to full stretch.

name: Jump Rope
howto: Jump with small hops using your wrists to turn the rope. Land softly on your toes.
